messages:
ana: Quick question about SA JWT -> OIDC flow in the Node SDK. I'm seeing a stream reconnect that ends up using the wrong project scope after a token refresh. Anyone else hit this?

mohit: hm. Can you paste the minimal repro or config? is this Dedicated/Hosted/private?

ana: Hosted for now. Using service account JSON with project_id set, then client = RedwoodClient({auth: {type: 'service_account', keyFile: '/secrets/sa.json'}, project: 'orgA'}) and opening a streaming completion. After ~50s the SDK does automatic reauth and the subsequent token has aud set to the default project instead of orgA.

jess: that sounds like the token-exchange fallback we added last quarter. We had a bug where refresh used the keyfile.project_id when project was explicitly set on the client.

sam: can you share the raw auth header from before/after refresh? `Authorization: Bearer <token>` decode the JWT -> check `aud` and `iss` and any `org`/`project` claims.

ana: pasted snippet (sanitized):
```
# before refresh
{ aud: "https://api.redwood.ai/orgs/orgA/token", sub: "sa@redwood.iam", proj: "orgA" }
# after refresh
{ aud: "https://api.redwood.ai/orgs/default-project/token", sub: "sa@redwood.iam", proj: "default-project" }
```

mohit: yup repro. Looks like our refresh path reads project from the keyfile first, then client config second. Should be client config > explicit call param > keyfile.

jess: I can sketch a quick patch: change token_manager.getRefreshPayload to accept an explicit project arg and prefer `clientConfig.project` when present. Also add a unit test for streaming reconnect that asserts aud remains the same.

ana: that would be great. For a hotfix, any workaround? Can pin project on env var?

sam: you can set REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT or pass project in every request as `client.stream({project: 'orgA'})` but that's ugly. Another quick workaround: set project_id in the SA keyfile to the desired project (not ideal).

mohit: patch looks small. I'm going to open a PR against main with tests. Will include a regression test that simulates token rotation during an active stream (mock clock + fake refresh).

jess: please mention SDK version in PR description. This affects node SDK <= v1.3.3; v1.3.4 has partial fix for non-streaming flows.

ci-bot: PR opened: #4323 by mohit — "fix(auth): prefer client project on refresh to avoid streaming drift" (ci checks running) :white_check_mark:

ana: awesome, thanks. Any estimate for patch release?

mohit: if CI is green and review is quick, can cut v1.3.5 today.

sam: once released, we should post a short note in #eng-runtime + add a migration note in SDK changelog (call out explicit project precedence).

jess: also add an e2e in our infra repo that spins up a tiny hosted test to assert stream continuity across refresh. Might avoid future regressions.

ana: I'll validate in my app once v1.3.5 is out and report back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
